Subject: RFI: On-prem deployment capabilities questionnaire

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Sequoia HealthTech is compiling technical responses for an on-prem/private deployment RFI and we'd appreciate Redwood's detailed answers to the attached questionnaire (attached: SH-RFI-Appendix-A.xlsx).

High-level areas we need covered:
- Deployment modes supported (VPC peered deployments, customer-managed on-prem appliance, fully air-gapped installs)
- Networking & egress controls (firewall, NAT, proxy support, outbound allowlists)
- Data-at-rest and in-transit encryption, KMS/HSM integrations and key custody models
- OS/hypervisor requirements, hardened images, and patching cadence
- SOC 2 / third-party attestation and evidence pointers
- Typical install/upgrade runbook, rollback, and support escalation matrix

Can you provide a fillable copy and any supporting diagrams or runbooks? Ideally by EOD Wednesday PST so our procurement and security teams can proceed with the timeline.

Also please call out any known limitations for offline/air-gapped installs (e.g., model updates, telemetry) and expected time-to-provision for a 2-node GPU cluster.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Procurement, Sequoia HealthTech
lydia.park@sequoiacorp.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0176
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@sequoiacorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: On-prem deployment capabilities questionnaire

Hi Lydia,

Thanks — appreciate the checklist. Attached is a completed capability matrix and two supporting artifacts: network_topology_v2.png (example VPC + on-prem peering), and soc2_summary_redwood.pdf (high-level attestation summary). I also attached a mutual action plan (MAP-Sequoia-20260830.docx) with an initial timeline and deliverables.

Quick answers / highlights below (see attachment for row-level detail):
- Deployment modes: Hosted API (not relevant here), Dedicated (single-tenant in our cloud), Private: VPC peering, customer-managed private control plane, and full air-gapped bundle for on-prem. Air-gapped installs require periodic model syncs via shipped artifacts; we document an offline update process.
- Networking & egress: Supports customer-managed NAT/proxy, allowlist-based egress, and optional outbound-block mode. Control plane telemetry can be disabled for air-gapped installs.
- Encryption/KMS: Data-at-rest uses AES-256; we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault for VPC-based deployments. For on-prem/HSM, we support KMIP and PKCS#11-compatible HSMs (we've validated with Thales and AWS CloudHSM). Key custody options include customer-owned keys and Redwood-managed keys (customer choice).
- OS/Images & patching: We publish hardened images (Ubuntu LTS baseline) and provide detailed package lists. Patching cadence: minor security patches monthly, full image refresh quarterly; emergency patches ASAP with advisory.
- Install/runbook: We included a condensed install runbook in the attachment; full runbook is available in a private Drive link after NDA. Rollback: image snapshot + service-level checkpointing; we support canary config rollouts.
- Evidence & attestations: SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA; we've included a summary and the expected process to request the full report.

Open items for our team to confirm for Sequoia-specific deployment:
1) Target OS/hypervisor preference (bare metal vs VMware vs K8s on-prem)
2) KMS/HSM vendor on your side for integration testing
3) Estimated window for on-site/network team to support provisioning (porta? firewall rules)

I've copied a couple of folks on our side to help with evidence and the technical walkthrough. If it helps, we can schedule a live install walkthrough next week.

Regards,

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego@redwoodinference.com

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Forwarding Sequoia's questionnaire and my initial responses (attached). Can you review the following points and confirm before I send the full runbook link under NDA?

1) KMS/HSM: I noted KMIP and PKCS#11 and that we've validated with Thales & AWS CloudHSM. Priyom — can you confirm the exact firmware versions we tested and whether YubiHSM is supported?

2) SOC 2: Laura — I included the one-page summary, but Sequoia asked for evidence pointers. Can you confirm: (a) expected NDA template reference, and (b) whether we can provide redacted control evidence for network segmentation controls?

3) Air-gapped model updates: Our doc mentions shipping signed model bundles. Any standard checklist we want to include for customer verification (hashes, signature verification steps)?

Action: please review redwood_private_deploy_matrix.xlsx and the network_topology_v2.png. I'll hold off sending full Drive link until Laura confirms NDA steps.

Thanks,
Diego
